about: Questions for the assistant's intent detection (docs/phase2-design.md §12.1). expect: the intent and arguments, or clarify (the right answer is to ask back). safe: other outcomes that are acceptable (asking back is always safe for ambiguous and unknown questions). thread: the question needs the record from the previous turn. Used by test/orchestratorIntents.test.js (router, CI) and scripts/intent-accuracy.js (real Groq).
